Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for the draft. Quick legal notes after review of the MSA and the proposed Implementation Exhibit: 

1) MSA references: please ensure the amendment explicitly references MSA v3.1 and the Order Form; add the following language to the signature block: "This Amendment is effective as of the last signature and is subject to the MSA dated March 1, 2026 between Redwood Inference, Inc. and EdgeBeam, Inc."

2) Limitation of liability / credits: we should avoid automatic credits tied to smoke test failures. Instead propose a remediation plan clause and capped service credit not to exceed one monthly fee for pilot months.

3) Data handling: Implementation Exhibit must state that any customer data used in acceptance testing will be limited to anonymized test traffic or production data with EdgeBeam's written consent; include references to our SOC 2 controls (we'll provide evidence on request).

4) Procurement + pricing: $0.009/tok-hour is acceptable for a short-term pilot, but accounting needs a clear invoice milestone (signature date triggers onboarding fee; capacity charge starts on go-live date). Please confirm target invoice dates.

5) Execution mechanics: I recommend we use DocuSign for the amendment and include an appendix showing the exact exhibit text to avoid post-signature ambiguity. Also request a DocuSign envelope that includes EdgeBeam's PO reference.

Suggested edits are inline in the attached redline (redlines-msA-exhibitA-implementation.docx). I highlighted where the acceptance criteria should include success metrics (e.g., 95th pctile latency under X ms for 7/10 test windows) and rollback triggers.

If no major objections, I'll prepare a short legal blurb for the DocuSign envelope and confirm the language for the Service Credit cap.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
